prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 26 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1347; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of acute low back pain radiating to the right buttock, with muscle spasm and reduced lumbar range of motion. Initial examination showed paraspinal tenderness and a positive straight leg raise on the right at approximately 45 degrees. Imaging was not indicated at the time of presentation given the absence of red-flag findings and neurological deficit.

Treatment consisted of a combination of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise focused on core stabilization and lumbar mobility, and modalities for pain and inflammation control. The patient completed a total of 26 visits over the course of care. Pain scores improved steadily from initial presentation, and functional tolerance for sitting, lifting, and prolonged standing progressively increased.

At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full lumbar range of motion, resolved muscle spasm, and independent performance of a home exercise program. Residual mild intermittent discomfort with prolonged forward bending was noted. Return to usual work and daily activities was approved with ergonomic precautions. Follow-up care on an as-needed basis was recommended should symptoms recur.
